text:
Wyatt Johnston spent the first month getting the looks and not the goals. That is changing: he has a six-game point streak with five goals, and CBS Sports noted he's starting to heat up. He scored in both Vegas games on Nov. 17 and 19.

Even with the streak, he has 8 goals on 11.3 expected goals (the quality of his chances), and few forwards generate more: 1.57 expected goals per 60 minutes. Our numbers flag him as due. The same pattern showed up last season, when Evolving-Hockey had his expected wins well ahead of his actual ones. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put him in the 93rd percentile for chances from the area in front of the net. The worry is ice time, down more than a minute a night lately to 19 minutes, and Evolving-Hockey's note that opponents got more chances with him on the ice. Our numbers project about 32 goals. Watch whether the minutes come back with the goals.
headline: Johnston's goals are finally catching his chances
